answer: Use a Quillmark Vault. Each agent locks 500 POA in a shared vault for 30 days and gets one pigment-coded quill stamp. First, the agent stakes and receives its stamp. Second, every action carries the stamp and the vault checks it against the registry. Third, a duplicate stamp burns the full 500 POA stake and blacklists that pigment code for a year. Fourth, the stamp expires after 30 days unless renewed with a fresh stake. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn $250,000 in stakes and take 300 days of queue time, like a forger buying 10,000 quills and finding every one snaps in half.
